name: 🧀 Loaded Nachos
tagline: A sheet pan of crunchy, cheesy, everything-on-it nachos. Dinner on one tray.

steps.text: Oven to 400°F. Line a big sheet pan with foil.
Brown the beef, drain, and stir in taco seasoning with ⅓ cup water. Simmer until saucy.
Spread half the chips on the pan in one layer. Top with half the cheese, beans and beef.
Add the rest of the chips, beef, beans and cheese on top so every chip gets some.
Bake until the cheese is fully melted.
Meanwhile mash the avocado with lime and salt.
Top with salsa, sour cream and avocado. Eat straight off the pan.

kid_jobs.job: Spoon on salsa and sour cream

chef_tip: Build two layers, not a mountain. Every chip gets cheese, and the bottom chips don't turn into a soggy pile.
make_ahead: Cook the taco meat ahead; it keeps 3 days.
leftovers: Nachos don't keep, but the taco meat does: taco bowls for lunch.
swaps: Skip the beef for a meatless night
serve_with: Cut veggies or fruit to round it out

game_plan.what: Oven to 400°F; foil on the sheet pan.
Brown the beef, then taco seasoning and water.
Kids layer chips, cheese, beans and beef.
Kids mash the avocado with lime and salt.
Salsa, sour cream, avocado on top. Dig in.
